message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data before it is consumed; batch tensors are constructed directly without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice, and there are no checksum verifications, signed URLs, or pinned revision references anywhere in the shown code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model files via `extract_model_file` and references model file paths (e.g., `cfg.model_file`) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of loaded weights.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (make_batch, epoch, encode_audios) converts raw batch tensors directly to torch tensors without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: Although a detect_nan utility exists in __init__.py, it is never called on model outputs in the inference path; no probability bounds or NaN/Inf guards are applied to returned predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio/visual multimodal pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
